info.title: RealAdvisor Inbox API
info.description:
Shared mailbox API backed by Neon Postgres.

## Authentication
Hosted documentation and API require a Cloudflare Access browser login. Requests from this page use your existing same-origin session. All allowed users can access registered live mailboxes. Only designated mailbox administrators may create them. Local development is synthetic and loopback-only.

## Automation / n8n
Service-token authentication and scoped workflow permissions are NOT implemented yet. Do not copy browser cookies into n8n. A future integration will use a dedicated Access service token and backend service-identity verification; creating a token alone will not work today.

## Mail identities
Each registered name@ingest.realadvisor.com mailbox sends as name@realadvisor.com. Public-address forwarding from Google Workspace is configured separately.

## Interactive requests
Requests execute against the current origin. Sending, modifying and deleting affect real data on the hosted instance. No external request proxy is used.

post.description: In live mode, only users listed in MAILBOX_ADMINS can create mailboxes, and creation must be enabled. The email must use ingest.realadvisor.com, with a 1–64 character lowercase local part containing letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number; consecutive dots are forbidden. Case is normalized to lowercase. Registration and system folders are committed atomically. Existing addresses return 409. The shared routing rule immediately permits this registered inbox, and sending uses the matching @realadvisor.com identity. Google Workspace/Groups forwarding for the public address is a separate step. Local synthetic mode remains unrestricted.

get.description: Page-based pagination. Query searches subject, sender, recipient and body as a literal substring. Filters combine with AND. date_start is inclusive; date_end exclusive. threaded=true returns the latest matching email per thread. Mail arrival can shift page boundaries; deduplicate workflow processing by email UUID. Tags are returned on every message. Tag filtering never joins duplicate assignment rows into the result.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description: Active conversation tag UUID. Applied before thread grouping, counting and pagination; combined with other filters using AND.

parameters.name: needs_review
parameters.description: When true, only conversations with unresolved classifier reviews or errors are returned. Excludes disabled classifiers and manual tag decisions. Applied before grouping, counting and pagination.

401.description: Missing or invalid authentication; the Access edge may redirect anonymous browsers to login.

post.description: Sends real mail in live mode. Caller supplies recipient, subject and body, including quoted/forwarded content if desired. Replies retain the thread; forwards start a new one. Store one UUID per logical send and reuse it with identical content on retry. A reused key with different content or a pending/unknown delivery returns 409. A provider ambiguity returns 502: inspect delivery before attempting another send. sent means provider acceptance, not final delivery. Local mode returns simulated and sends nothing.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required in live mode; retain across retries.
